description: Capabilities and constraints of key Azure services relevant to architecture diagramming

usage_notes.general: Use this information to accurately represent Azure services in architecture diagrams and ensure compliance with best practices.
usage_notes.enforcement: Enforce these capabilities and constraints when generating diagrams. If a requested service violates these rules, either adjust the diagram to comply or provide a clear justification for the deviation.

vnet_integrated_services.rule: Draw outside VNet boundary with dashed integration link

paas_external_services.rule: Draw outside VNet boundary and connect via Private Endpoint

subscription_representation.rule: Subscriptions MUST be represented as cluster boundaries, never as service icons
